compiled_state.description:
## Context
Bug dbe8-cf03-ed53-47e7 fixed autodeploy.sh so a comment-only edit to a watched Gerrit config file does not emit AUTODEPLOY_ERROR config_manual (Gerrit change 3095, commit 67137e66e99). Tests cover it with a stubbed git; no live commit has exercised it on the host yet.

## Approach
Wait for the next commit that edits only comments or whitespace in a path in CONFIG_PATHS (infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh), then read the host journal for the deploy of that commit. If no such commit lands within a reasonable time, close as not observable.

## Testing
Read-only: journalctl -u rebar-autodeploy.service on the Gerrit host for the deploy window of that commit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The journal for the deploy of a comment-only config commit contains no config_manual AUTODEPLOY_ERROR (checked: journalctl output recorded in a ticket comment with the commit sha).
compiled_state.title: Confirm a live comment-only config commit no longer emits config_manual
